run_compute_accuracy_single_task: run the script to compute accuracy for a single task like image or edit using a predictions JSON file
run_compute_accuracy_all_tasks: run the script to evaluate all four MMRB2 tasks by providing four prediction JSON files in order
run_compute_accuracy_with_output: run the script with an output flag to save accuracy results as a JSON file to disk
compute_task_accuracy: compute accuracy for a single task by comparing predictions against benchmark ground truth pairs with forward and reverse evaluation
flip_judgement: flip a judgement string from A to B or B to A for reverse evaluation comparison
